title: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment
what_it_is: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment

sections.label: 30x30 Express grant local food
sections.summary: The 30x30 Express grant supports agri-food players to accelerate local food production over the next six to 24 months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: While our food supply has remained stable, we have launched the "30x30 Express" grant to support agri-food players to accelerate local food production over the next six to 24 months.

sections.label: Climate science and sea level research
sections.summary: A Climate Science Research Programme Office will be set up end-2020, a S$10 million National Sea Level Research Programme launched, and resources set aside in the Coastal and Flood Protection Fund.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The Climate Science Research Programme Office will be set up in end-2020 to drive efforts to formulate Singapore's national climate science research masterplan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We have already launched a S$10 million National Sea Level Research Programme to develop more robust projections of rising sea levels, and we are setting aside dedicated resources in the Coastal and Flood Protection Fund to protect Singapore against rising sea levels.

sections.label: Water and food security measures
sections.summary: Singapore will expand Changi NEWater Factory, roll out smart meters in 300,000 premises by 2023, diversify food imports and pursue the 30 by 30 goal.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To enhance water security, we will continue to build up weather-resilient sources such as by expanding the Changi NEWater Factory.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will invest in technology to stay ahead of the curve in water management and conservation, including the rollout of smart meters in 300,000 premises by 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To ensure food security, we will intensify efforts to diversify our imports, strengthen our food supply chains, and realise our goal to produce 30% of Singapore's nutritional needs locally by 2030 ("30 by 30" goal).

sections.label: Circular economy and green jobs
sections.summary: Closing resource loops via NEWSand and NEWOil reduces supply shock vulnerability and extends Semakau Landfill's lifespan, with 4,000 new and upgraded jobs expected next year and 55,000 over 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Closing our resource loops locally and turning trash into treasure will reduce our vulnerability to global supply shocks and extend the lifespan of Semakau Landfill.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We are pushing boundaries in Circular Economy by transforming waste treatment residue into construction materials (or "NEWSand"), and discarded plastics into higher value products like pyrolysis oil (or "NEWOil").

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As we pursue sustainable development, the MSE family expects to create 4,000 new and upgraded jobs in the next year, and 55,000 over the next 10 years.

sections.label: Reviewing Environmental Control Officer scheme
sections.summary: The Environmental Control Officer scheme will be reviewed to broaden ECOs' work areas beyond construction sites to more premises, creating new opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As we raise environmental sanitation and waste management standards, this will create new good jobs for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will review the Environmental Control Officer (ECO) scheme to broaden the work areas for ECOs beyond construction sites to more premises, which will create new opportunities for individuals like operations or facilities managers looking to establish high environmental standards in the premises they oversee.

sections.label: SG Eco Fund launch
sections.summary: As part of SG Together, the $50 million SG Eco Fund is launched to support projects on environmental sustainability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As part of SG Together, we are launching the $50 million SG Eco Fund to support projects on environmental sustainability.
